privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads or remote resources.
drop: Drop a DOC, WPS, or WPT file here
formats: Read a legacy Word document or a compatible WPS Writer file.
invalid: This document is damaged or incomplete. Try saving a new DOC copy in your office application.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a DOC, WPS, or WPT file with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
protected: This document is encrypted or password protected. Save an unencrypted copy in your office application first.
unsupported: This document format is not supported here. Choose a Word 97–2003 DOC or a compatible WPS Writer file. Microsoft Works, older WPS formats, and DOCX files need a different reader.
noContent: This document has no readable content. It may be blank or contain only unsupported objects.
noHeadings: No recognized headings. Scroll to read the document.
reflow: Continuous reading layout. Fonts, list numbering, spacing, columns, and page boundaries may differ from your office application.
changes: Tracked changes appear as if accepted: added text is shown and deleted text is hidden. The original file is unchanged.
limited: Some content cannot be displayed fully. Unsupported objects, missing or linked pictures, and complex formatting may be omitted.
safePreview: External links, remote resources, macros, and active content are disabled. Internal references may be unavailable in the preview. Use the outline to reach recognized headings.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the preview.
omitted: Headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, and comments are not displayed. Text boxes may appear after the main text; complex drawings and embedded applications may be omitted.
